tclock.advanceByHint: An ISO-8601 duration, for example P3D (3 days) or PT2H (2 hours).

A validity block that aligns to the financial year end takes fiscalStartMonth (1 to 12) and, optionally, fiscalStartDay (1 to 28; empty means the 1st), for example "validity": {"period": "P1Y", "alignTo": "FISCAL_YEAR_END", "fiscalStartMonth": 4, "fiscalStartDay": 1}.

modeller2.title: Modelling tools
modeller2.takeoverHint: {{who}} holds the edit lease. Taking it over is recorded in the audit trail with your reason; their unsaved draft is kept.
modeller2.leaseRequested: {{who}} asks to edit this model. Save your work and close it to hand over.
modeller2.compareHint: Compares by meaning: elements, flows, expressions and properties. Layout changes are not counted. Nothing is stored.
modeller2.compareResourceHint: Its extension picks the format: .bpmn, .bpmn20.xml, .dmn, .cmmn or .json for a form.
modeller2.compareSideHint: Paste the model text or load a file. Leave it empty for a new or a deleted file. At most 5 MiB.
modeller2.compareLoadBefore: Load the old version from a file
modeller2.compareLoadAfter: Load the new version from a file
modeller2.compareUseCurrent: Use the saved version of this model
modeller2.compareUnreadable: These versions cannot be compared. Each side must be a readable BPMN, DMN, CMMN or form file without a DOCTYPE, both sides must be the same format, and at least one side must have content.
modeller2.diffNoChanges: No change in meaning between the two versions.
modeller2.templatesDesc: Process, element and form component templates.
modeller2.judgedHint: Non-deterministic. Listed apart from the tests above.

op4.removalHint: Starts a batch over the historic instances of this definition. Choose one: recalculate, a fixed time, or clear.
op4.permissionsHint: Permissions are names for the chosen resource type, for example ["READ","UPDATE"], ["ALL"] or ["NONE"].
op4.varValueHint: Value is JSON: "text" for a String, 5 for a number, true or false, null. For Object, Xml or Json put objectTypeName and serializationDataFormat in value info.

links.title: Links
links.desc: Links between processes, cases and tasks.

bulk.title: Bulk ingest
bulk.desc: Load many records in one job: upload a file in chunks, close the job, then follow every row. Chunks are checked and stored by the server; sending the same chunk again is safe.
bulk.noJobs: No bulk jobs for the object types you may load.
bulk.objectTypeHint: The kind of record to load. The server checks that you may load it (ops.variable: process variables, tenant administrators).
bulk.expectedChunksHint: Optional. When given, the job closes only after this many chunks.
bulk.positiveWhole: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
bulk.uploadHint: CSV needs an externalId column; the other columns become the row data. JSON is an array of {externalId, data}; NDJSON is one such object per line. Rows are sent in chunks, in file order, starting after the chunks already received.
bulk.parseErrors: {{n}} entries could not be read and will not be sent:
bulk.oversize: {{n}} rows are larger than the byte limit by themselves, for example {{ids}}. Shorten them or raise the limit.
bulk.duplicates: {{n}} externalIds appear more than once, for example {{ids}}. Each occurrence becomes its own row.
bulk.tooManyChunks: This job expects {{n}} chunks in total; the file needs more. Raise the rows per chunk or split the file.
bulk.quotaExceeded: This chunk is larger than the tenant's batch-size quota: {{allowed}} rows allowed, {{requested}} sent. Set the rows per chunk to {{allowed}} or fewer and send again; chunks already received are not sent twice.
bulk.limitExceeded: The server refused the chunk as too large: {{detail}}. Lower the rows or bytes per chunk and send again.
bulk.notOpen: Uploads are possible only while the job is open.
bulk.closeHint: No more chunks can be added. The server then processes every row.
bulk.abortHint: Rows not yet processed are cancelled. This cannot be undone.

actions.runHint: Runs on {{subject}}. Running it again with the same request is safe: the server returns the first result.
actions.inputHint: Optional. The values the action needs.
actions.replayed: This action had already run for this request; the first result is shown.
actions.targetHint: BPMN: the process key to start. REST: connectorId:operation (a registered connector and one of its operations).

cf.title: Custom fields
cf.desc: Extra fields a tenant adds to its forms. Each field has dated versions; a retired field keeps its stored values.
cf.keyHint: x_ followed by lower-case letters, digits or _, for example x_ward_no.
cf.label: Label
cf.defineHint: Types: string (formats decimal, integer-string, date, date-time, email), integer, boolean, array. A decimal is {"type": "string", "format": "decimal"}. A field cannot be both required and read only.
cf.retireHint: From this date the field is no longer asked for. Values already stored stay readable.

packs.desc: Packs installed for a tenant: roll back to the previous version or uninstall. Platform administrators only; every change is audited with its reason.
packs.none: No packs are installed for this tenant.
packs.rollbackHint: The previous version is deployed again as a new patch version. Running instances keep their version.
packs.uninstallHint: Removes every version of the pack from the tenant. Refused while instances run or another pack depends on it.

reason.PACK_NOT_INSTALLED: This pack is not installed for this tenant.
reason.PACK_HAS_DEPENDANTS: Other installed packs depend on this pack. Uninstall them first:
reason.PACK_HAS_LIVE_INSTANCES: Process or case instances of this pack are still running:

reason.PACK_VERSION_NOT_SEMVER: An installed version is not MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, so the next version cannot be computed:

promo.planHint: Load a bundle exported from another environment. The server checks its signature and shows what would change here.

err.PROMOTION_SAME_ENVIRONMENT: The bundle comes from this environment. Promote it to a different one.

err.PROMOTION_NO_CHANGE: The target already has this configuration.
